M.Sc Health Data Science Student Profile 
Batch 2025-2027

Preface 
The MSc Health Data Science programme at SRM prepares graduates at the intersection of 
healthcare, data, statistics, and technology, with a strong emphasis on learning through 
real-world application. Our programme is designed to provide students with a strong 
foundation in healthcare, data science, statistics, research methodology, and emerging 
technologies, with a strong emphasis on practical and experiential learning. Throughout the 
programme, students gain hands-on experience working with real-world healthcare data as 
well as datasets obtained from online and publicly available repositories, enabling them to 
develop 
skills 
in 
data 
management, 
analysis, interpretation, visualization, and 
evidence-based decision-making. 
An important component of the curriculum is industry exposure at the end of the first year, 
through which students gain first-hand experience of professional work environments and 
the application of health data science in real-world settings. This experience helps students 
understand industry workflows, data-related challenges, professional expectations, and the 
translation of academic knowledge into practical solutions. 
Our graduates develop proficiency in Python, R, SQL, machine learning, deep learning, 
Power BI, Tableau, large language models, dashboard development, Electronic Medical 
Records (EMR), Hospital Information Systems (HIS), and healthcare data analytics, alongside 
strong capabilities in research, statistics, and problem-solving. The combination of academic 
learning, hands-on work with real-world datasets, research projects, and structured industry 
exposure equips our students to contribute effectively to organizations working in 
healthcare, health technology, analytics, research, hospitals, pharmaceuticals, and related 
sectors. 
We would be pleased to facilitate campus placement and recruitment opportunities at SRM, 
or coordinate with your organization for an appropriate selection process at your 
convenience. We look forward to establishing a meaningful association with your 
organization and providing opportunities for our graduates to contribute their knowledge 
and skills to the healthcare and data science ecosystem. We are confident that our graduates 
are ready to work independently and contribute to the organization they get associated 
with. 
We can organize campus placement events at SRM or send these graduates to your 
organization for selection. 
Dr Prakash M 
Associate Professor and In-charge Student Placement 
Prakashm6@srmist.edu.in
